body:
incident-bot: ALERT — p99 latency SLO breach for /v1/chat/streaming detected (window 1m). p99=1.92s (> SLO 1.2s). Streaming stall rate +12% in last 5m. Auto-page to oncall.

matt: paging — got it, I'm oncall. joining.

sara: I'm on the dashboard. p95 ~ 430ms, p99 ~ 1.9s. Tail spikes coincide with bursts of template-heavy prompts and `json_mode=true` requests. Check tokenizer queue length up ~3x.

ravi: seeing increased CPU on preproc workers (prompt-assembly). Top ops: prompt-template expansion and tool-schema assembly. JSON parse times up too for large tool payloads.

matt: copying logs, can someone dump a recent trace for a stalled streaming request?

sara: pulled a sample span — streaming stalled during prompt-construction step for ~800ms before sending tokens to runtime. Trace snippet:
```
preproc.expand_template -> 420ms
preproc.assemble_tools -> 230ms
tokenizer.encode -> 85ms
runtime.stream_start -> immediate
```
Most of time is in expand_template/assemble_tools.

ravi: Notebook quick metrics: median template tokens added ~120, but expansion time scales superlinearly with number of tool schemas. A recent PR increased nested schema rendering.

jenny: support: two customer tickets flagged timeouts for long streaming jobs in the last 10m. Both on Dedicated customers with large tool sets. Notified them we're investigating.

andrew: product — did we push any prompt-template changes in last deploy window? Iirc there was a change to allow richer tool-schema interpolation.

matt: checking deploy log... ops-bot: deploy-events show `deploy-frontend-2026-02-14T02:40:00Z` included PR #789-template-interp.

sara: that PR changed how we render tool schemas into prompts (more deep recursion + JSON escape). Looks like worst-case expands schema inline rather than referencing. Might be the culprit.

matt: immediate mitigation options:
- revert PR #789 (rollback template interp) — will require deploy, ~10m to rollback + validation
- enable temporary rate-limit for `json_mode=true` or for tenants with large schema — instant via rate-limit-config
- short-circuit heavy template expansion by using fallback compact template variant (existing feature) for affected tenants
- scale preproc workers (autoscale) — helpful but still expensive CPU work

ravi: we can flip a config toggle to prefer compact tool-template rendering for all requests older than N tokens. I can prepare a hotfix to short-circuit deep recursion.

sara: I'm going to warm caches for common templates (KV cache) and bump preproc replica count by +30% from the console. Doing that now.

matt: jenny — please message the two impacted customers with ETA ~30m for partial mitigation and offer workaround (use compact template flag or lower tool payload).

jenny: on it. will send a short note and post updates here.

ops-bot: Scaling preproc service: replicas from 12 -> 16 initiated.

sara: cache priming in progress: hitting top 50 templates, warming KV. Also a small config push to prefer compact rendering for requests with tool-schema > 5KB (feature-flag: compact-tool-render=true) — toggled ON.

ravi: rolling hotfix to short-circuit expansion for deeply nested schemas. Patch: `if depth > 3 then render-ref` — deploying to canary.

matt: canary looks good for 2 minutes, latency p99 on canary traffic ~0.9s.

sara: cluster-level p99 is dropping: from 1.9s -> 1.25s in last 4m after compact toggle and cache warm.

andrew: customer impact: estimated 1.7% of overall traffic affected, but for dedicated tenants up to 15% saw stalls. Good to note in postmortem.

jenny: customers notified, one accepted compact-template workaround, other requested ETA for full rollback.

matt: decision: keep compact-tool-render=true for now, merge and rollout hotfix to prod, follow up with rollback if hotspot persists. Start full rollback of PR #789 if metrics don't normalize in 30m.

sara: hotfix merged — rolling out to all preproc nodes. watching.

ops-bot: Hotfix rollout to preproc: 100% in 6m.

ravi: after hotfix, we see preproc CPU 25% lower for heavy requests and tokenizer queue length back to baseline. p99 now stable ~1.05s.

matt: excellent. calling this a live mitigation. Not closing the incident yet — need deeper root cause: template interpolation design flaw and missing guardrails for large tool schemas.

andrew: next steps for postmortem:
- root cause writeup: PR #789 changed inline expansion behavior
- add guardrail: reject/compact overly large tool schemas at API ingress
- add perf tests for template expansion (scale tests)
- alerting: create anomaly alert for preproc expansion time
- customer remediation plan and follow-up comms

jenny: logging customer impact details to support ticketing system.

sara: scheduling a follow-up runbook update for compact-template fallback + steps to flip flag and warm cache.

matt: oncall handoff: I'll remain until 03:30Z, then hand to sara if still monitoring. If stabilization holds, we will de-escalate at 03:15Z.

jenny: updated customers — they appreciate fast response. marking tickets with mitigation steps.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: live mitigation applied — compact-tool-render flag ON, hotfix deployed, preproc scaled. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring. Next update due in 15m.

matt: thanks everyone. I'll start the timeline and assign owners for the postmortem items. tagging @andrew for comms, @ravi for root-cause, @sara for runbook, @jenny for customer follow-up.

sara: accepted handoff if needed.

matt: closing active paging loop. will update thread with postmortem link once ready.
